title: Equitable list-coloring conjecture
statement: For every finite simple graph G and every integer k greater than its maximum degree, every assignment of a k-element color list to each vertex has a proper list coloring in which no color is used more than ceil(|V(G)|/k) times.

counterexample.description: A finite simple graph, an integer k≥Δ(G)+1, and one k-list assignment for which exhaustive search proves that every proper list coloring overuses some color.
